context:
Goal: every design skill stays global and pinned (decision design-skills) while Claude Code keeps moving up.
Problem (rule): from claude-code 2.1.312, frontend-design comes from claude-plugins-official at main, which changes under us. No marketplace setting can pin it: a commit hash is ignored, a ref takes only a branch or tag, and that repo has no tags.
Based on (measured): lane/fd-official-pin, 2 review rounds, head 6ea3b529 (lane renovate-917-918).
Departs from: main pins claude-code below 2.1.312 — options b and c change how frontend-design is pinned; option a holds claude-code at 2.1.311.

lastAnswer.note: "Goal: every design skill stays global and pinned (decision design-skills) while Claude Code keeps moving up" I thought we agreed that any sort of update thing our rule now is that we stay as current without conflicts or somtehing like that -- kinda means this ruling was out of date and somehow our audits didnt catch this ??? (makes me concerned.)

options.gain: Frontend-design stays pinned, with no change.
options.how: Keep the claude-code pin at 2.1.311 and close Renovate's 2.1.312+ PRs until a pinned route exists.
options.label: Hold Claude Code at 2.1.311 for now
options.lose: You miss newer Claude Code fixes.

options.gain: Claude Code moves up and the skill stays pinned.
options.how: Copy the frontend-design skill folder into this repo at a fixed version, as impeccable is.
options.label: Keep our own pinned copy of frontend-design
options.lose: Someone updates the copy by hand.

options.how: Accept claude-plugins-official at main and rewrite decision design-skills to allow it.
options.label: Let frontend-design float, and rewrite design-skills
options.lose: Goes against your design-skills ruling: each design skill is global and pinned.

ref: step renovate-917-918; decision design-skills; Renovate PR #917
reply: Built pick c: design-skills now says frontend-design floats and pins take the newest version that passes. Claude Code stays at 2.1.311 for now: from 2.1.312 a fresh session does not install frontend-design (0 of 8 starts), so that bump fails the check.
title: Newer Claude Code makes frontend-design float. How do we keep it pinned?
why: Your pick c, Nov 1 11:43 CST: frontend-design follows Claude Code's newest version, and decision design-skills is rewritten to match (lane fd-float-cc-newest, 37fa928b, with the batch runner).
